answer: To register, an agent locks a vote-escrowed stake that cannot move as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. The fault is proven by grading-consensus scoring when an agent is caught grading peers far from the panel verdict. Conviction means a fraud proof triggers slashing at once, no jury needed. Think of the bond as a wharf: locked, visible, forfeitable. No zenith hides a shared bond: funding flows are public. Every sparrow here is a bond that can be cut.
